# papersize

The goal of papersize is to provide you with convenience functions
extending grid, ggplot2, and patchwork to help in sizing plots and files
for printing to paper, postcards, playing cards, and other physical
media.

## Installation

You can install the development version of papersize like so:

``` r

# pak::pkg_install("elipousson/papersize")
```

## Example

``` r

library(papersize)
```

papersize includes data on standard paper sizes including sizes for
papers (ANSI, ISO, and other standards), photo prints, postcards, and
playing cards.

``` r

get_paper("Letter")
#>      name series size standard units width height orientation  type       asp
#> 19 Letter   <NA> <NA>     ANSI    in   8.5     11    portrait paper 0.7727273

get_paper("Letter", orientation = "landscape")
#> # A data frame: 1 × 10
#>   name   series size  standard units width height orientation type    asp
#> * <chr>  <chr>  <chr> <chr>    <chr> <dbl>  <dbl> <chr>       <chr> <dbl>
#> 1 Letter <NA>   <NA>  ANSI     in       11    8.5 landscape   paper  1.29

get_card("Poker")
#> # A data frame: 1 × 10
#>   name       series size  standard units width height orientation type    asp
#> * <chr>      <chr>  <chr> <chr>    <chr> <dbl>  <dbl> <chr>       <chr> <dbl>
#> 1 Poker card <NA>   <NA>  <NA>     in      2.5    3.5 portrait    card  0.714
```

papersize includes plotting functions that create lists of ggplot2 plots
with repeated elements that can be assembled with patchwork into page
layouts for print.

For example,
[`plot_cards()`](https://elipousson.github.io/papersize/reference/plot_cards.md)
creates a list of Poker-card sized plots that can be tiled onto a
letter-size patchwork to save and print.

``` r

papersize <-
  plot_cards(
    "Poker",
    n = 8,
    number = TRUE,
    border = TRUE,
    size = 4,
    linewidth = 0.5,
    text = rep(c("\U2664", "\U2661", "\U2662", "\U2667"), 2),
    color = "yellow"
  )

papersize[[1]]
```

![](reference/figures/README-plot_cards-1.png)

``` r

page_layout(
  plots = papersize,
  page = "Letter",
  orientation = "landscape"
)
#> ℹ Using `dims` from first plot in `plots`.
#> $`1`
```

![](reference/figures/README-layout_cards-1.png)

This more involved example uses the internal
[`add_card_border()`](https://elipousson.github.io/papersize/reference/add_card_border.md)
function to apply rectangular elements to the card plot:

``` r

card <- get_card("Poker card")

card_center <- card
card_center[["x"]] <- 0
card_center[["y"]] <- 0
card_offset <- card_center
card_offset[["y"]] <- 0.75

card_plots <- plot_cards(
  "Poker card",
  fill = "white",
  linetype = "solid",
  color = "black",
  linewidth = 0.45,
  n = 8,
  border = TRUE,
  inset = 0
)

card_plots[[1]]
```

![](reference/figures/README-unnamed-chunk-2-1.png)

``` r

# Add outline of image
bordered_cards <- add_card_border(
  card_plots,
  card = card_offset,
  color = "black",
  linewidth = 0.25,
  linetype = "solid",
  inset = c(0.2, 1)
)

bordered_cards[[1]]
```

![](reference/figures/README-unnamed-chunk-3-1.png)

``` r

bordered_cards <- bordered_cards |>
  add_card_border(
    card = card_center,
    color = "gray50",
    linewidth = 0.25,
    linetype = "solid",
    inset = c(0.1, 0.1)
  )

bordered_cards[[1]]
```

![](reference/figures/README-unnamed-chunk-4-1.png)

Card plots are then assembled in a page ready for export, printing, and
cutting:

``` r

card_page <- page_layout(
  plots = bordered_cards,
  page = "Letter",
  orientation = "landscape"
)
#> ℹ Using `dims` from first plot in `plots`.

card_page[[1]]
```

![](reference/figures/README-unnamed-chunk-5-1.png)

papersize currently has limited features but additional features are
expected to include better support for multi-page layouts, control over
the position of card elements, preset card formats/designs, and
appropriate handling of cut-lines for DIY card printing.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`area_unit_options`](https://elipousson.github.io/papersize/reference/area_unit_options.md)
  : Area units (vector)

- [`as_asp()`](https://elipousson.github.io/papersize/reference/as_asp.md)
  : Convert character string, page name, or page data.frame to numeric
  aspect ratio

- [`as_page()`](https://elipousson.github.io/papersize/reference/as_page.md)
  : Coerce a character or named vector to a page data.frame using
  get_page_size() or make_page_size()

- [`as_unit()`](https://elipousson.github.io/papersize/reference/as_unit.md)
  [`as_unit_type()`](https://elipousson.github.io/papersize/reference/as_unit.md)
  [`convert_unit_type()`](https://elipousson.github.io/papersize/reference/as_unit.md)
  [`is_unit_type()`](https://elipousson.github.io/papersize/reference/as_unit.md)
  [`is_same_unit_type()`](https://elipousson.github.io/papersize/reference/as_unit.md)
  : Helper functions for grid units

- [`card_sizes`](https://elipousson.github.io/papersize/reference/card_sizes.md)
  : Standard card sizes

- [`convert_dist_scale()`](https://elipousson.github.io/papersize/reference/convert_dist_scale.md)
  : Convert distance from scale to actual units

- [`convert_dist_units()`](https://elipousson.github.io/papersize/reference/convert_dist_units.md)
  : Convert distance (and area) values between different units

- [`dist_unit_options`](https://elipousson.github.io/papersize/reference/dist_unit_options.md)
  : Distance units (vector)

- [`dist_units`](https://elipousson.github.io/papersize/reference/dist_units.md)
  : Distance units (data frame)

- [`get_page_size()`](https://elipousson.github.io/papersize/reference/get_page_size.md)
  [`get_paper()`](https://elipousson.github.io/papersize/reference/get_page_size.md)
  [`get_card()`](https://elipousson.github.io/papersize/reference/get_page_size.md)
  [`get_page_dims()`](https://elipousson.github.io/papersize/reference/get_page_size.md)
  [`convert_page_units()`](https://elipousson.github.io/papersize/reference/get_page_size.md)
  : Get a paper or card size based on name, dimensions, orientation, or
  type

- [`get_scale()`](https://elipousson.github.io/papersize/reference/get_scale.md)
  : Get standard scales and convert to scale distances

- [`get_social_size()`](https://elipousson.github.io/papersize/reference/get_social_size.md)
  : Get social media image size to match platform and format

- [`ggsave_ext()`](https://elipousson.github.io/papersize/reference/ggsave_ext.md)
  [`ggsave_social()`](https://elipousson.github.io/papersize/reference/ggsave_ext.md)
  [`map_ggsave_ext()`](https://elipousson.github.io/papersize/reference/ggsave_ext.md)
  : Save a ggplot2 plot to file and update file EXIF metadata

- [`grid_units`](https://elipousson.github.io/papersize/reference/grid_units.md)
  : Grid units (vector)

- [`inset_page_element()`](https://elipousson.github.io/papersize/reference/inset_page_element.md)
  : Create an inset with page size dimensions be added on top of the
  previous plot

- [`is_dist_units()`](https://elipousson.github.io/papersize/reference/is_dist_units.md)
  [`get_dist_units()`](https://elipousson.github.io/papersize/reference/is_dist_units.md)
  [`as_dist_units()`](https://elipousson.github.io/papersize/reference/is_dist_units.md)
  [`is_same_units()`](https://elipousson.github.io/papersize/reference/is_dist_units.md)
  : General utility functions for working with distance units objects

- [`make_contact_sheets()`](https://elipousson.github.io/papersize/reference/make_contact_sheets.md)
  **\[experimental\]** :

  Use
  [`magick::image_ggplot()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/magick/reference/image_ggplot.html)
  to make contact sheets for images

- [`make_page_size()`](https://elipousson.github.io/papersize/reference/make_page_size.md)
  : Make a page size data frame

- [`margins()`](https://elipousson.github.io/papersize/reference/margins.md)
  [`is_margin()`](https://elipousson.github.io/papersize/reference/margins.md)
  [`get_margin()`](https://elipousson.github.io/papersize/reference/margins.md)
  : Specify the margins of a page or element

- [`page_extras`](https://elipousson.github.io/papersize/reference/page_extras.md)
  : Extra reference data for page layouts

- [`page_layout()`](https://elipousson.github.io/papersize/reference/page_layout.md)
  : Use patchwork to lay out a list of fixed aspect plots on a larger
  page

- [`page_to_layout()`](https://elipousson.github.io/papersize/reference/page_to_layout.md)
  : Convert a page size data.frame to a Grid layout object

- [`page_to_viewport()`](https://elipousson.github.io/papersize/reference/page_to_viewport.md)
  :

  Convert a page data.frame to a `viewport` class object

- [`paper_sizes`](https://elipousson.github.io/papersize/reference/paper_sizes.md)
  : Standard paper and image sizes

- [`plot_cards()`](https://elipousson.github.io/papersize/reference/plot_cards.md)
  : Use ggplot to plot for one or more cards

- [`print_to_page()`](https://elipousson.github.io/papersize/reference/print_to_page.md)
  [`print_to_page_layout()`](https://elipousson.github.io/papersize/reference/print_to_page.md)
  **\[experimental\]** : Explicitly draw plot using dimensions from page
  data.frame or list

- [`set_page_dims()`](https://elipousson.github.io/papersize/reference/set_page_dims.md)
  [`set_page_orientation()`](https://elipousson.github.io/papersize/reference/set_page_dims.md)
  [`set_page_asp()`](https://elipousson.github.io/papersize/reference/set_page_dims.md)
  : Set page data.frame dimensions, orientation, or aspect ratio

- [`set_page_margin()`](https://elipousson.github.io/papersize/reference/set_page_margin.md)
  : Set margins for page data.frame (adding body width, height, and asp)

- [`standard_scales`](https://elipousson.github.io/papersize/reference/standard_scales.md)
  : Standard map, architectural, and engineering scales

- [`theme_page()`](https://elipousson.github.io/papersize/reference/theme_page.md)
  : Modify plot aspect ratio to match a page size
